items.followUp: What is one benefit of sharing files over a network?

rubric.why: Recognises that file sharing makes files available for sharing or access.
rubric.description: File sharing is the process of making files available to others.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying files being made available or shared.

rubric.why: Identifies who can access the files or how they are shared.
rubric.description: The files are made available to other users or computers, commonly over a network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning other users/computers or a network.

modelAnswer: File sharing is the process of making files available to other users or computers.
It is commonly done over a network so that files can be accessed or transferred.

items.followUp: What is the main function of the Transport Layer in the OSI model?

rubric.why: Identifies the Application Layer’s position in the OSI model.
rubric.description: The Application Layer is the seventh and topmost layer of the OSI model.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as the seventh layer or the topmost layer.

rubric.why: States the layer’s role in providing network services to applications.
rubric.description: It provides network services to application programs and acts as an interface between applications and the network.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing its provision of network services to applications or its interface role.

modelAnswer: The Application Layer is the seventh and topmost layer of the OSI model.
It provides network services to application programs and serves as an interface between applications and the network.
